articleTitle: Multimodal Recommendation Systems in the LLM Era: A Survey of Feature Representation and Fusion Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: The surge in multimodal data such as text, images, and sometimes audio, has led to a growing interest in recommendation systems capable of integrating these diverse modalities for enhanced personalization. Multimodal recommendation systems leverage such rich data to better understand user preferences and provide highly tailored recommendations. Traditional approaches employ a variety of techniques, including feature alignment, modality-specific graphs, attention mechanisms, and advanced fusion strategies, to effectively combine multimodal information. Recently, the integration of large language models (LLMs) into multimodal recommenders has transformed the field, enabling advanced preference summarization, context-aware fusion and even personalized content generation. This survey provides a comprehensive overview of both the traditional and LLM-based multimodal recommendation systems, highlighting their architectures, key methodologies, datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and real-world applications. Furthermore, we explore the challenges and opportunities posed by the fusion and processing of multi-modal data by these recommender systems.

articleTitle: Optimizing Byte Pair Encoding Tokenization for South African Languages
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce an Optimized Byte Pair Encoding (OBPE) tokenizer where the algorithm is optimized for the South African languages, including Sesotho, Setswana, Xhosa, Xitsonga, and Zulu. Our approach is tailored to handle the characteristics of multilingual datasets and language complexity, especially regarding the morphological richness of South African Languages. Firstly, we incorporate language-specific tokens to facilitate learning of language-specific context and differentiation when training the algorithm on multilingual corpora. Secondly, we modify the existing BPE algorithm to add common words derived from the multilingual corpus to the initial vocabulary, which helps to reach convergence faster and possibly get more meaningful or accurate tokenization. Thirdly, we introduce a common words parameter that allows the user to specify the number of common words derived from the corpus to be used for the initial vocabulary of the algorithm. Our OBPE achieved accuracy of 96% compared to the traditional BPE (87-88%).

articleTitle: A Comparative Study to Evaluate the Performance of Selective Models in Software Vulnerability Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Software vulnerability detection is one of the essential tasks in cybersecurity; its main target is to identify security defects in software and mitigate them. In this paper, the dataset CVEfixes is investigated and evaluated using various machine learning algorithms: eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGB), Random Forest (RF), and Naive Bayes (NB), in addition to a deep learning model based on 1D Convolution Neural Network (1D−CNN). A comparison has been conducted between these models, where CNN has outperformed in accuracy but had lower recall and f1-score for the vulnerable samples, indicating weakness in capturing this class. In contrast, XGB, with lower accuracy, had achieved the best f1-score for the vulnerable class.

articleTitle: FA-F2FS: Fast Append for Flash-Friendly File System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Modern computers enhance I/O performance through parallel I/O, yet due to the scalability issues of file systems, parallel I/O cannot achieve the desired performance improvement. In this paper, we find that F2FS has scalability issue in append write. To address this issue, we propose FA-F2FS, the Fast Append Flash Friendly File System, which extends F2FS. We first identify the root cause of F2FS limited scalability in append write: contention on the Global Dirty List Lock. We then implement three mechanisms to address this limitation. First, we use inode-level fine-grained read-write locks to enhance parallelism in marking inodes as dirty. Second, we replace the Global Counter with the Per-CPU Counter, enabling parallel counting instead of serialized counting. Finally, we optimize access to the Global Dirty List by implementing Double-Checked Locking. We implement FA-F2FS in Linux kernel 5.10.1 and evaluate it on both synthetic and realistic workloads across two different scales of servers. Under realistic workloads in Filebench, FA-F2FS achieves 1.68× and 1.49× the throughput compared to the baseline F2FS for the FileServer and WebServer workloads, respectively. In the FxMark DWAL workload, FA-F2FS demonstrates at least 2× the throughput of F2FS.

articleTitle: AutoML Anomaly Characterization Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: As datasets become increasingly complex, traditional anomaly detection methods often fall short, necessitating more sophisticated techniques. This paper introduces a novel AutoML method for identifying and classifying a wide range of data anomalies, in complex datasets. This approach effectively manages null anomalies and deviations from standard deviations through robust statistical analysis and the intentional introduction of text and null errors in numeric features. Tested on five diverse datasets, the method demonstrated flawless performance in identifying a high percentage of induced errors and accurately distinguishing between different types of data features and anomalies. This preliminary study highlights the method's potential for further application and validation on datasets with real-world anomalies and untested anomaly types, aiming to enhance data quality assessment both before and after processing.

articleTitle: A Text Summarization Model for the Yorùbá Language
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Text summarization is important in this era of electronic data explosion. While there exist different models for text summarization in High-resource languages like English, there is no automatic text summarization model for the Yorùbá language. Leveraging the large language and pre-trained language models, a text summarization technique for the Yorùbá language which fine-tunes the mT5 model with a monolingual Yorùbá dataset is proposed. The model implemented is a transformer-based sequence-to-sequence abstractive text summarization model which trained the mT5 model using the XL-Sum Yorùbá bilingual dataset. We assess the effectiveness of the model in summarising Yorùbá text, providing insight into its ability to extract valuable information from a large amount of textual input. The Yorùbá text summarization model we developed achieved the following ROUGE scores, 41.27 for ROUGE-1, 19.77 for ROUGE-2, 30.57 for ROUGE-L, and 30.59 for RogueLsum. The outcome demonstrates reasonable Yorùbá text summarization, setting a base standard for further text summarization models for the Yorùbá language.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach to Forecasting Demand in Fashion Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Fashion apparel retail is lucrative, dynamic, and unpredictable, as it is influenced by a wide range of factors, including culture, economics, social media, and fashion trends. Due to these influences, coupled with the industry's inherent need to innovate, track customer preferences and global trends, and introduce new products, demand and sales forecasting are particularly challenging. Since the fashion apparel industry has a high degree of uncertainty, the methods available for demand forecasting in other industries are more difficult to apply. Data analysis and forecasting are becoming increasingly automated through the use of ML (Machine Learning) tools and algorithms. Our research suggests such tools and algorithms might be applied to fashion. This proposed model presents a forecasting method that can be used to develop a collection and manage production and supply chains by fashion retailers, based on their existing products as well as the model's assessment.

articleTitle: Research on Data Governance of Salt Cavern Gas Storage Based on Data Standardization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: To effectively address the issues of unclassified and underutilized data in the process of informatization, digitalization, and intelligent development of salt cavern gas storage, oil and gas pipeline enterprises need to organize and implement effective data governance. With the continuous development of informatization in domestic salt cavern gas storage, in order to fully leverage the role of enterprise production and operation platforms in value discovery and management efficiency improvement, there is a need for a multidimensional data governance method for salt cavern gas storage based on data standardization. This method aims to construct a cross-isolated data and provide a consistent data management ecosystem, with core components including data standards, data quality management, and full lifecycle data management. By conducting the aforementioned data governance activities, the monitoring of production and operation in enterprises can be effectively enhanced, along with data quality, serving as a reference for data governance in other enterprise-level data centers.

articleTitle: Operational Technology: The New Role of Enterprise Architecture in the Context of IT & OT Convergence
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Technological convergence triggered by the evolution of automation and information technologies is already a reality in the industry. This development has led to convergence, merging previously segregated Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) areas. Technological and structural convergence aims to increase cybersecurity and productivity and significantly reduce costs for projects and the maintenance of industrial assets. Good practices from two previously isolated areas must be merged to reinforce the best in each. Enterprise architecture (EA), one of these practices, must be included in the daily routine of operational technology projects. However, current EA frameworks do not deal with operational technologies. This paper proposes a supplement to current architecture frameworks, including the OT activity area, as a vital part of the technological convergence process’s success.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of NL2SQL Technology Based on LLM for Big Data of Enterprise Finance
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Currently, the research field of Natural Language Generated SQL (NL2SQL) mainly focuses on generic datasets, aiming to build models that can parse natural language queries and automatically generate SQL statements. However, this generic exploration often ignores the complexity and idiosyncrasies of intra-enterprise data, such as industry-specific terminology, data structure differences, and security compliance requirements, resulting in the fact that the existing NL2SQL technology can only cover the more basic query requirements in practical applications, and is difficult to be deeply integrated into the business scenarios of enterprises. This paper aims to fill this research gap by focusing on the customized application of NL2SQL technology to specific internal enterprise environments, and adopting LLM+RAG+Reminiscence Engineering+Intelligent Body Feedback to design and implement a set of NL2SQL system that can be applied to internal enterprises. After practical project verification, the system’s ability to generate SQL in an enterprise-oriented financial data environment can be improved from 54% to about 70%, and the accuracy of multi-round dialog can be further improved. This system enables the seamless connection between natural language and enterprise database, which provides strong support for enterprise digital transformation.

articleTitle: Research on Building the Science and Technology Evaluation Scientific Data Center of Gansu Province Utilizing Hadoop and ThinkPHP Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Through analyzing the construction of scientific data both domestically and internationally, the resource construction system for establishing a scientific data center for scientific and technological evaluation is clarified, and the Gansu science and technology data center for scientific and technological evaluation is constructed. Based on key technologies such as QR algorithm, Hadoop technology, and ThinkPHP framework, the functional requirements of the system are analyzed. The construction of the resource system is scientifically planned, the system architecture is designed, data import and export are optimized, and the Gansu science and technology evaluation scientific data center system is constructed to ensure the comprehensive aggregation and efficient integration of data and to realize the expansion of applications. Through the construction of the Gansu science and technology evaluation scientific data center, centralized storage and efficient display of scientific and technological data are achieved. The collection, collation, storage, and management of scientific data are comprehensively planned, and the utilization efficiency of scientific data is enhanced. It provides comprehensive, accurate, and timely data support for scientific and technological evaluation and also offers a powerful basis for scientific and technological decision-making, promoting scientific and technological innovation and development, and contributing to the scientific and technological progress and economic development of the Gansu province.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management: The Influencer to Business Model Innovation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Given today’s global business environment, companies are wrestling with how best to confront and adapt to ever-changing conditions as part of their overall business strategy. The success of business model innovation as part of defining and developing new market opportunities requires the foundation of a sound knowledge management strategy. The focus of such a strategy needs to be based on value creation and value contribution within the firm. Value creation can only be achieved by identifying strong knowledge management capabilities to act as underlying building blocks. These capabilities are supported further by knowledge enablers. A well-choreographed knowledge management strategy will consider all three elements. The use of a knowledge management framework called the knowledge house will help provide context for the discussion of value contribution, capabilities, and enablers. By applying an overall strategic road map, a path to value is presented that contributes to unlocking new markets and product offerings and therefore helps the firm adapt to constantly changing market and economic conditions.

articleTitle: Measures Contributing to the Success of DevOps Processes: Development of a Reference Model to Actively Stimulate Customer Involvement
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: To implement DevOps processes of Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery or Continuous Deployment (CI/CD-processes), the software industry tries to tackle a plethora of challenges. Specific characteristics of CI/CD-processes emphasize the importance of customer involvement. Although it would appear obvious to involve the customer more closely into CI/CD-processes, literature seems to underexpose the exact role of the customer. The involvement of customers needs more attention to fit the goal of CI/CD-processes. Therefore, measures concerning the aspect of customer involvement contributing to the success of CI/CD-processes found in literature need more empirical evidence. This study aims to contribute to the success of CI/CD-processes by developing a relevant reference model of measures to actively stimulate customer involvement. We followed three phases. In the first phase, we conducted a systematic literature review to find potential customer-oriented measures. We applied in the second phase a metaplan method to classify the potential measures per CSF. This resulted in a baseline model of six wide-ranging CSFs and seventeen potential customer-oriented measures. Since we needed a reference model of measures which actively stimulate customer involvement we conducted a multiple case study in the third phase. We used the baseline model to collect data to be able to develop the reference model. We asked for real-life examples of measures and corresponding explanations on why the taken measures stimulate customer involvement. Next, we classified the explanations found. Based on the classified explanations, we developed a reference model of measures to actively stimulate customer involvement. This study extends the literature by a structured reference model of measures to actively stimulate customer involvement. In addition, we showed that our methodology enabled the development of a model exclusively focused on measures of customer involvement from a wide-ranging yet customer-oriented baseline model.

articleTitle: TFQS: HBase-based Cache Optimization Model for Secondary Index
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Advanced Enterprise Information System (AEIS)
abstract: Data is characterized by large scale, diversity, velocity and low value density in the Internet of Everything era. Traditional relational databases face significant challenges in efficiently storing and querying large volumes of heterogeneous data. In particularly, healthcare data not only has the features of big data but also real-time capability, privacy, security, and time dependency. The effective management of such data is currently a hot research topic. HBase is a widely used NoSQL database in big data applications, which provides fast write throughput and high concurrency. However, the query on non-rowkeys columns is low due to that filters are combined with a full table scan to complete one query. To overcome this problem, we propose a new cache optimization algorithm TFQS (Temperature Frequency Queue Segment) which improve data retrieval efficiency by building HBase non-rowkeys secondary index with Elasticsearch. In additional, TFQS can improve memory efficiency, further increasing query speed and efficiency. Finally, comparative experiments were performed on the real healthcare data set MIMIC-III. The results show that TFQS enhanced performance of conditional queries by approximately 75.6% compared to HBase, and by around 58.5% and 28.7% compared to Phoenix and Solr respectively. Our solution yielded 18 times and 8.7 times improvements on range queries compared with Phoenix and Solr. Cache hit rate is about 10.4% higher than native HBase.
